moments.text: Infrared sensor view with corner brackets around the crosshair on a dark, shaded background. A white box right of centre slides off the right edge.
The image flashes bright and smeared for a few frames, then settles on an even grey surface; the corner brackets are gone.
Grey sea surface with a small square at the crosshair centre; the view drifts slowly.
A small dark ring appears right of the crosshair. A white box enters from the right edge, locks around it and carries it to the crosshair.
The white box holds the small dark spot at the crosshair centre for about 17 seconds.
The white box disappears; only the bare crosshair remains over the grey surface and the dark spot is no longer visible.
The crosshair vanishes and the background turns streaky. A tiny light spot sits near the right edge, just below centre, until the end.
